fieldMapping.note: HubSpot deal ID used as external identifier to match or create Account
Website domain from HubSpot deal properties to search or set on Salesforce Account
Deal name used as Account name when creating a new record

assumptions: The HubSpot deal webhook payload includes 'deal.id' and 'deal.properties' with 'domain' and 'name' fields.
Salesforce has an Account object with a custom external ID field (external_id__c) that will store the HubSpot deal ID for matching.
When no matching Account is found, a new Account will be created using the deal name as the Account Name and the domain as the Website field.
The integration will perform a SOQL query on Salesforce Account using the Website field to find an existing record before upserting.

notes: HubSpot sends webhook payloads via POST to a subscriber-defined URL; the URL is configured in app settings or via the Webhooks API.
The payload structure varies by subscription type; for deal updates, expect top-level fields like 'dealId' and 'properties' containing deal data.
To receive deal property updates, subscribe to the 'deal.propertyChange' event type requiring crm.objects.deals.read scope.
Custom properties are supported in webhooks only if they exist in the portal; otherwise no webhook is sent for that property.
The webhook may include multiple events per request; batch processing is recommended.
HubSpot enforces HTTPS and a concurrency limit of 10 requests per portal.
Uses the sObject Rows by External ID endpoint to upsert Account using external_id__c as the external ID field.
HTTP 200 indicates update; HTTP 201 indicates create.
Response includes 'created' flag in API v46.0+ to distinguish create vs update.
If external_id__c is not unique or duplicated, returns HTTP 300 with error details.
No native pagination; this is a single-record upsert.
To upsert based on Website domain instead, a prior SOQL query is required (not covered here).
The instance URL (e.g., na1.salesforce.com) must be obtained from login or token response.
